full_page.content:
Page 226 Aug. 8 Thanks - Louis Jaminet - 45 - operation on the pancreas-organ of the stomach - seemingly recovering - one case in 10 oc's .... Ellen Roele - 67 - has peculiar groth on hip. - Cancer feared. Mrs. Cleo Burrell - 47 - "of the Holynes Church" - breast cancer fears operation - Husband Episcopelian.
Mrs. H. Baker - Elderly - Episcopelian nerveous break. .. Nixon Vancooey - 8 - infantile paral ....
Fred. Orlikawski - 18 months - lost hearing thru sickness - high fever three months ago. - just learning to talk - Father not going to Church
Ethel Kilkline - 38 - non C. not well - mother asks for prayers. Joan Jiendl - non C. - child 11 mos.
Mrs. Bertha Klinger - 51 - large goiter - fears operation. Thom. Easton - 62 - Brain tuomer - nothing of nourishment.
Page 227 Aug. 14 Dolores Macklin - 25 - lost hearing when only 18mos. old. from high fever has never regained - otherwise well.
Elmer Macklin - 53 - bleeding kidnies - Drs. have little hopes.
Otto H. Klipp - 48 - 30 yrs. paralized - never joined a church - reads Bible and has quite a little faith.
Eds'd Salley -37 - operation for ulcer of stomach Dec. 5th last seemed improved for short time - now worse ... wife and two children beg for prayers.
Wm. L. Reno - 64 - High-blood-pressure, etc. Widower has four child- ren ....
Sister M. Raymund and mistress of novices of Dubuque ask prayer that mother of former - consent to her daughter joining.
Mrs. Eliz LaMerr - 68 - serious bowel obstruction - second operation feared
